Model & evidence

From local surroundings to possible heat.

The local-environment model downscales a network heat condition using nearby greenery, HDB building form, coastline exposure and geographic position. It estimates local variation; it does not predict tomorrow's weather.

Station-held-out MAE1.011°C

Every fold excludes one complete location

Station-held-out RMSE1.482°C

2,210 hourly station observations

Grouped R²0.845

Validation grouped by weather station

Peer-station background → local spatial features → regularised residual model → spatial-support guard → calibrated heat-index interval

01

Weather background

The same-hour station network supplies the background heat condition, so the model learns local differences rather than pretending weather is static.

02

Local environment

Parks, HDB footprints and height, building density, coastline proximity, latitude, longitude and CBD distance describe each neighbourhood.

03

Guarded inference

Predictions far from known station profiles are conservatively pulled toward the network background instead of extrapolating without bound.

Completed B1 implementation

Six integrated capabilities, connected end to end.

The backend combines current station heat with mapped local environment features, then refreshes local estimates and planning-area views with explicit uncertainty.

01 · Implemented

Live station heat index

Latest temperature and relative-humidity readings are paired into a current heat index across the station network.

02 · Implemented

Local environment heat estimate

A separate model estimates possible heat from nearby vegetation, buildings, coastline exposure and location at selectable radii.

03 · Implemented

Planning-area Heat Risk Score

A separately trained classifier combines heat conditions, official 2026 age structure and mapped eldercare access across 55 planning areas.

04 · Implemented

Tiered recommendations

Low, Medium and High classes drive a ranked review queue and response prompts.

05 · Implemented

Weather + spatial inputs

Public station observations provide the background while mapped environment layers describe local conditions.

06 · Implemented

Cooling intervention simulator

High-risk areas can be tested with added cooling points and a green-corridor shade proxy.

Responsible use & data lineage

Evidence, provenance and human review built in.

Research local estimate

The output combines public station and spatial data into a possible local heat estimate while official public guidance remains with Singapore's responsible agencies.

Demographics are contextual

Planning-area and subzone age structure uses official 2026 statistics. HDB-building population values are modelled estimates and are labelled accordingly.

Mapped support access

MOH eldercare points provide a consistent indicator of nearby community support for planning review.

Human review stays in the loop

Risk tiers prioritise inspection and support decisions alongside official public guidance.
